policy_dsl: |-
  scope: forum.comment
  match:

      - regex: "绝对稳过"
  context_modifiers:
    - if: is_after_exam_discussion

  thresholds:
    allow: "< 0.40"
    hold: "0.40 - 0.80"
    mask: "0.80 - 0.92"
    block: ">= 0.92"

  - 绝对稳过，包你上岸
  - 这份资料绝对稳过
examples_negative:
  - 希望大家都稳过
  - 稳过线了吗
